messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "maximum dose"
set: ["maximum dose", "dose increases should not exceed maximum recommended dose", "up to a maximum first dose of 50 mg", "no separate maximum dose applies on the basis of age", "maximum is 400 mg a day", "800 milligrams per dose or 3200 mg per day (4 maximum doses)", "do not exceed the maximum single dose of 150 mg for immediate-release tablets", "about 4 days: acid-lowering effect reaches maximum with once-daily dosing", "dose", "oral suspension in children 2 years and older: 0.125 mg/kg orally once a day (to a maximum dose of 7.5 mg/day)", "low dose", "recommended dose", "dose change", "dose titration", "given as two divided doses up to the same maximum 37.5 mg daily limit", "increase dose slowly"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "dose increases should not exceed maximum recommended dose",
    "up to a maximum first dose of 50 mg",
    "no separate maximum dose applies on the basis of age",
    "maximum is 400 mg a day",
    "800 milligrams per dose or 3200 mg per day (4 maximum doses)",
    "do not exceed the maximum single dose of 150 mg for immediate-release tablets",
    "oral suspension in children 2 years and older: 0.125 mg/kg orally once a day (to a maximum dose of 7.5 mg/day)",
    "given as two divided doses up to the same maximum 37.5 mg daily limit"
  ],
  "alias": "maximum dose"
}
